action_space_spec.note: lerobot/pi0 HF port: PaliGemma-3B VLM + gemma-300m flow-matching action expert; emits 50-step chunk of 6-d actions (SO-100/ALOHA-class joint space). NOTE: upstream Physical Intelligence pi0 is typically 14-d dual-arm EE deltas; this lerobot port config is 6-d single-arm. NOT our 20-d UR/dVRK layout.
action_space_spec.chunk: 50 actions per inference (n_action_steps=50), flow-matching 10 denoise steps

weights.framework: torch port of openpi (JAX not needed)

caveats: repo ships no dataset normalization stats -> STATE/ACTION normalization is identity; returned actions are in normalized space
saved config.json rejected by lerobot 0.6.1 draccus parser (deprecated keys) -> built PI0Config manually with identical values
saved policy_preprocessor.json pins device=cpu -> moved tensors to cuda manually
images: 3 real frames reused as camera0/1/2 (640x480 native matches config)
first-call inference 2.55s on GB10 (fp32); model load ~409s one-time
